title: hydrocotyle vulgaris var. vulgaris
intro: Hydrocotyle vulgaris var. vulgaris, commonly known as Pennywort or Gotu Kola, is a plant species in the mint family that is native to Europe, Asia, and Africa. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, which include improving memory, reducing inflammation, and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Pennywort include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions such as arthritis, eczema, and skin ulcers. Bioactive constituents of Pennywort include triterpenoid saponins, flavonoids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
